cohort: The study included pregnant women expected to deliver in 2015 in Pelotas, southern Brazil, encompassing 4252 babies born spontaneously and 23 babies born after ART.
finding: Children conceived via ART exhibited lower gestational age, birth weight, length, and head circumference at birth, with over 90% of this negative effect mediated by the higher incidence of multiple pregnancies rather than ART itself.
